messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I am using fieldimageR for pollen count but getting below mentioned error message (red colored, bold, image attached):

> library(FIELDimageR)
> library(FIELDimageR.Extra)
> library(raster)
> library(terra)
> library(mapview)
> library(sf)
> library(stars)
 > # Uploading image
> EX.P<-rast("P4.jpg")
> # Reducing image resolution (fast analysis)
> EX.P<-aggregate(EX.P,fact=4)
> plotRGB(EX.P, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3)
> # Using index "BIM" to remove background (above 19)
> EX.P<-imgLAB(EX.P)
> EX.P.R1<- fieldMask(mosaic = EX.P,index = "BIM", cropValue = 19, cropAbove = T) [1] "3 layers available"
> fieldView(EX.P.R1$newMosaic) [1] "Starting analysis ..." [1] "End!"
> # Counting all pollens area>1000 (all sample)
> EX.P.Total<-fieldCount(mosaic = EX.P.R1$mask, plot=T)

Need help to solve this.

messages.subject: Re: Field Count Error.
messages.body_plain:
Hi Martin,

Try installing EBImage in R (https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/EBImage.html):

install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("EBImage")

However, your image is going to be almost impossible to count using our segmentation approach. The plants must be very well separated shapes.

Hope it helps,
Filipe

messages.subject: Standard deviation values from an orthomosaic
messages.subject_clean: Standard deviation values from an orthomosaic
messages.body_plain:
Hi everybody!

I was wondering if it is possible to extract the standard deviation instead of the average values from an orthomosaic I've seen that we can use the function fun = "mean, sum, min, max, or summary". However, the information generated in "summary" does not generate labels for all the columns, which makes it difficult to understand what information is generated.

Code I am using:
data <- fieldInfo_extra(mosaic = index1, fieldShape = shape, fun = "summary")

messages.subject: Re: Standard deviation values from an orthomosaic
messages.subject_clean: Standard deviation values from an orthomosaic
messages.body_plain:
Hi there,

Try updating your version of "FIELDimageR_Extra".

It allows to use these functions: 'mean', 'sum', 'max', 'min', 'mode', 'stdev', 'variance', 'coefficient_of_variation', 'majority', and 'minority'.

Some plots can return NULL if there is no data (pixels or images) in the plot area!

Hope it helps...!

All the best,
Filipe
